title: Rexx/SQL SQLite: indexed provider composition and migration gates
summary: Native Database Backends v0.3.2 brings configuration-time provider-package selection into the canonical publication source and recognizes REXXSQL-SQLITE/REXXSQL/SQLITE as the existing indexed Rexx/SQL SQLite provider. The provider is external to Native Database Backends and remains owned by oorexx_rexxsql_backend_v0.1. Consumers may require capabilities before acquisition; unsupported NULL-vs-empty distinction and BLOB writes must fail closed. Semantic Source Store uses its specialized Rexx/SQL provider override to retain the SSC index plan. The v0.3.2 Git increment is source-complete for Autobuild but is not newly runtime-qualified until an exact receipt exists.
invariants: Rexx/SQL SQLite execution remains owned by oorexx_rexxsql_backend_v0.1; Native Database Backends must not duplicate or vendor its driver.
DatabaseBackendSelector chooses a provider package before implementation classes are imported; NativeDatabaseBackendSelector remains the capability selector among already-loaded implementations.
REXXSQL-SQLITE, REXXSQL and SQLITE normalize to the same provider identity.
A consumer requiring an unsupported capability must fail before session acquisition rather than silently weaken persistence semantics.
NULL_EMPTY_DISTINCT and BLOB_WRITE are currently unsupported by the Rexx/SQL provider; THREAD_SAFE_CONNECTIONS remains unqualified.
SSC uses SemanticSourceRexxSqlProvider through an explicit package/class override so its index plan is preserved.
Changing provider is deployment configuration; applications must not rewrite ::requires statements to switch databases.
No v0.3.2 runtime qualification may be claimed until an Autobuild receipt names the exact submitted source and result.
procedure: Set OOREXX_DATABASE_PROVIDER to REXXSQL-SQLITE, REXXSQL or SQLITE.
Ensure RexxSqlDatabaseProvider.cls and the canonical Native Database Backends src directory are on REXX_PATH and librexxsql.so is loadable.
Pass requiredCapabilities for every persistence semantic the application depends on.
Refuse acquisition if a required capability is not SUPPORTED.
For SSC, override OOREXX_DATABASE_PROVIDER_PACKAGE to SemanticSourceRexxSqlProvider.cls and OOREXX_DATABASE_PROVIDER_CLASS to SemanticSourceRexxSqlProvider.
Treat the acquired session as pinned; do not replay failed work through NoSQLServer or another provider.

provenance.claim: v0.3.1 is the immutable canonical parent for the v0.3.2 Git increment; v0.3.2 adds provider-package selection without replacing the parent provenance.
